sections.overview: A tiny marine snailfish recorded from the Crozet Basin in the western Indian Ocean.
sections.identification: Its very small eyes are a diagnostic feature and are reflected in the name microps.
sections.habitat: The species is known from a midwater trawl in deep oceanic waters.
sections.diet: The consulted accounts do not describe its prey.
sections.behavior: No species-specific behavior is reported in the consulted accounts.
sections.reproduction: The consulted accounts contain no reproductive observations.
sections.ecology: The known material is limited, so little can be said about its ecology. P. steini is another Crozet Basin congener; the published descriptions note its tan coloration, whereas the very small eyes distinguish this species.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists the species as not evaluated by the IUCN.
